description: This file contains a class and functions for managing YouTube video data within an ERP system, including fetching video statistics via the YouTube API, parsing video URLs, and batch updating video statistics.

classes.name: Video
classes.description: A Document subclass representing a YouTube video, with methods to validate, set video ID, and update statistics.

methods.name: is_tracking_enabled
methods.description: Checks if YouTube tracking is enabled in settings.

methods.name: get_frequency
methods.description: Returns numeric frequency value based on setting, defaulting to 1 hour.

methods.name: update_youtube_data
methods.description: Scheduled function to update YouTube video statistics based on configured frequency.

methods.name: get_formatted_ids
methods.description: Formats a list of Video objects into a comma-separated string of video IDs.

methods.name: get_id_from_url
methods.description: Extracts YouTube video ID from a URL string.

methods.name: batch_update_youtube_data
methods.description: Fetches and updates statistics for multiple videos in batches.
